post.summary:
POST /api/v1/runtimes/node/install
Installs a Node.js version, verifies SHA256 checksum, extracts archive, and enables corepack.

get.summary:
GET /api/v1/runtimes/node/versions
Lists all available Node.js versions (from official index.json or offline catalog),
indicating local installation status and site usage.

post.summary:
POST /api/v1/runtimes/node/{version}/corepack
Re-enables or refreshes corepack shims (`pnpm` & `yarn`) for an installed Node.js runtime.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Versi Node.js yang akan diaktifkan corepack-nya

post.summary:
POST /api/v1/sites/{id}/security/ban-ip
Blocks an IP address with optional TTL, updates database records, and applies Nginx deny rule atomically.

delete.summary:
DELETE /api/v1/sites/{id}/security/ban-ip/{ip}
Unbans an IP address, removes deny rule from Nginx, and recompiles vhost configuration atomically.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: IP address or CIDR to unban

get.summary:
GET /api/v1/sites/{id}/security/banned-ips
Retrieves the list of currently active banned IP addresses with remaining TTL countdown.
GET /api/v1/sites/{id}/ssl - Get SSL certificate status for a site.

delete.summary: DELETE /api/v1/sites/{id}/ssl - Disable SSL on the site and revert to HTTP.

post.summary: POST /api/v1/sites/{id}/ssl/custom - Upload custom certificate and private key.
POST /api/v1/sites/{id}/ssl/issue - Issue Let's Encrypt certificate with fallback self-signed.
POST /api/v1/sites/{id}/ssl/renew - Manually trigger renewal of the active certificate.
POST /api/v1/sites/{id}/ssl/self-signed - Issue a self-signed certificate directly.

AppRuntimeHintsDto.description: Hints for Node.js and Python runtimes.

ApplyOptimizerRequestDto.description: Request to apply an automated or custom server tuning profile.

AsvsRequirement.description: A specific control item in the OWASP ASVS audit.

ttl_secs.description: Duration in seconds. None indicates permanent ban.

CreateJobRequest.description: Request payload to enqueue a new background job.

payload.description: Arbitrary JSON payload for the job handler

CreateTerminalSessionRequest.description: Request payload to initiate a new PTY session.

cwd.description: Initial working directory. If omitted, defaults to tenant home directory.

CustomCertRequest.description: Request payload to upload a custom certificate.

auto_renew.description: Whether to mark for auto-renewal (for custom, default is false).

fullchain_pem.description: Full PEM certificate chain including leaf and intermediate certificates.

privkey_pem.description: PEM encoded private key matching the certificate.

DoctorCheckItem.description: An individual doctor diagnosis check item.

DoctorCheckStatus.description: Status of an individual doctor check.

DoctorReport.description: Comprehensive report produced by the doctor diagnosis.

DriftItem.description: An individual drift item between database state and actual system state.

DriftType.description: Type of state drift detected between database and actual system state.

IssueSslRequest.description: Request payload to issue an ACME / Let's Encrypt certificate.

email.description: Contact email for Let's Encrypt account. If omitted, uses tenant email.

fallback_self_signed.description: If ACME verification fails, fallback to generating a self-signed certificate. Default is true.

ocsp_stapling.description: Enable OCSP stapling in Nginx. Default is true for ACME certs.

staging.description: Whether to use Let's Encrypt staging environment (avoids rate limits). Default is false.

JobItem.description: Representation of a background job in API responses.

JobProgressEvent.description: Real-time progress event emitted during background job execution.

message.description: Optional progress log or error message

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when this event was emitted

NftablesSyncPayload.description: Request payload to trigger synchronization of nftables loopback guard rules.

NftablesSyncResponseDto.description: Response returned when nftables rules synchronization completes.

NodeRuntimeActionApiResponse.description: Response returned after a Node.js runtime action.

NodeRuntimeInstallApiRequest.description: Request payload to install a Node.js version.

NodeRuntimeListApiResponse.description: API Response containing the list of Node.js versions and metadata.

NodeSiteActionApiRequest.description: Request payload to trigger a Node.js process action.

NodeSiteJobApiRequest.description: Request payload to run a tenant job (npm install, build, script).

NodeSiteSettingsDto.description: Settings for a Node.js website process.

NodeVersionItemDto.description: Information about a single Node.js runtime version.

OptimizerActionResponseDto.description: Action response after applying or rolling back tuning profile.

OptimizerStatusResponseDto.description: Status and configuration overview of server optimizer.

OwaspAsvsAuditReport.description: Consolidated OWASP ASVS L2 audit report.

PanelMemoryProfileReport.description: Comprehensive panel memory profile and PRD Bab 9 target validation report.

PhpExtensionItem.description: Detailed information about an individual PHP extension.

PhpExtensionListApiResponse.description: Response containing all curated extensions for a specific PHP version.

PhpFpmActionResponseDto.description: Generic message response for PHP-FPM actions (reload, restart).

PhpFpmMasterOverviewDto.description: Overview information for a tenant's PHP-FPM master instance.

PhpFpmMasterStatusDto.description: Detailed status information for a specific master.

PhpRuntimeListApiResponse.description: Response containing all PHP runtime versions and PPA configuration status.

PhpVersionStatusItem.description: Status information of a specific PHP runtime version.

ProcessMemorySnapshot.description: Memory footprint snapshot of a process.

ProxyHeaderConfig.description: Configuration for a custom header in reverse proxy.

ReconcileReport.description: Comprehensive report of state reconciliation analysis.

SecurityHardeningOverviewResponse.description: Consolidated overview of system security hardening, OWASP ASVS audit, and firewall isolation.

SitePhpExtensionsResponse.description: Response containing per-site PHP extensions configuration.

SslStatusResponse.description: Response payload containing SSL certificate details.

SwitchPhpVersionRequest.description: Request payload to switch a website's PHP version.

SwitchPhpVersionResponse.description: Response returned after successfully switching a website's PHP version.

SystemBackupFileEntry.description: An entry of an individual file stored in the system backup archive.

SystemBackupManifest.description: Manifest containing metadata and checksums of the system backup snapshot.

SystemBackupSummary.description: Metadata summary of an existing system backup archive.

SystemBackupVerificationResult.description: Result of verifying a system backup archive.

SystemdDirective.description: Directive check inside systemd service security analysis.

SystemdServiceSecurityScore.description: Systemd service security analysis score conforming to `systemd-analyze security`.

TenantPortBindingDto.description: Loopback port binding for tenant application isolation.

TerminalAuditItem.description: Structured terminal audit item with duration, folder, and client IP.

TerminalAuditListResponse.description: Paginated list response of terminal audit events.

TerminalCloseApiResponse.description: Response returned when closing a session.

TerminalResizeRequest.description: Request payload to resize a terminal session window.

TerminalSessionResponse.description: Details of a running or terminated terminal session.

username.description: Linux system username the PTY is executing under

ToggleExtensionRequest.description: Payload for toggling an extension's enabled/disabled state.

force_vacuum.description: Force database VACUUM regardless of fragmentation threshold.

UpdateNodeSiteSettingsRequest.description: Request payload to update Node.js site settings.

auto_vacuum.description: Automatically run SQLite VACUUM during maintenance if fragmented.

max_db_size_mb.description: Maximum SQLite database file size limit in MB (min 50 MB, null for unlimited).

one_day_retention_days.description: 1-day metrics rollup retention in days (None or null for unlimited).

one_hour_retention_days.description: 1-hour metrics rollup retention in days (7d to 1000d). Default: 400.

one_minute_retention_days.description: 1-minute metrics rollup retention in days (1d to 90d). Default: 14.

raw_retention_hours.description: Raw metrics retention in hours (1h to 168h / 7 days). Default: 2.

security_events_retention_days.description: Security events retention in days (1d to 90d). Default: 7.

UpdateSitePhpExtensionsInput.description: Input payload to update per-site PHP extension overrides.

shell_policy.description: Desired shell policy ("none", "sftp", "full"), or null to inherit from plan.
